# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for the nightly workflow's `sanitizer (thread)`
# job (D-721, D-863). `cargo xtask sanitize thread` passes this file through
# `TSAN_OPTIONS=suppressions=…`.
#
# Only a report whose racing accesses (the top frames of each access) lie in
# a dependency (crossbeam, the precompiled parts of Rust's std, loom's
# generator) gets a line here, with a comment above it giving its reason and
# the run that showed it. A report in Cheby's own crates is fixed, never
# suppressed; behavior a decision makes intentional is told to the
# sanitizer instead (D-863).
#
# Format: one `race:<function or module>` (or `thread:`, `mutex:`, ...) per
# line; `#` starts a comment.

# crossbeam-deque's work-stealing buffer: `Stealer::steal_batch_and_pop`
# reads a slot speculatively (`Buffer::read`, deque.rs:107) while the owner's
# `Worker::push` writes it (`Buffer::write`, deque.rs:97), and the stealer
# then discards the value when its compare-and-swap of `front` fails. The
# deque orders these with fences ThreadSanitizer does not model; both top
# frames of each access are crossbeam's. Seen in `cargo xtask sanitize
# thread --step runtime` on macOS arm64, 2026-10-17
# (fiber_ops::select_tests::select_closed_arm_reads_the_chain: a worker's
# find_runnable stealing while a fiber's spawn pushes).
race:crossbeam_deque
